prompt:
Theme:
white cloaked in the sky

Subject:
A mature woman standing on a rooftop in a sunny city. The person is placed slightly to the right of center, captured from the top of the head to the thighs. The body occupies about 70% of the screen, looking quietly down at the low-positioned camera.

Character and Expression:
Bright skin with a natural complexion, sophisticated facial features. Sophisticated Japanese-style makeup with pink-beige lips, pale rose blush, thin brown eyeliner, and eyelashes that emphasize length without being overdone. Dark brown shoulder-length bob with thin bangs and layers around the face, hair ends and loose hairs swaying in the wind. Chin slightly tucked, looking at the lens with a calm, mature gaze, lips slightly open.

Clothing and Pose:
A lightly sheer ivory white blouse. Soft, not-too-deep V-neck, loose long sleeves, thin cuffs. Paired with a simple skin-toned beige camisole underneath, with just enough transparency for the chest and body silhouette to look elegant. Bottom is a pale ecru high-waisted pleated mini skirt. Upper body slightly tilted forward, shoulders relaxed, arms naturally lowered at sides. The thin fabric of the blouse and skirt hem sway gently in the wind, creating natural folds and shadows around the waist.

Environment and Light:
A rooftop of an urban apartment building. Metal fence at waist height, low-rise residential and apartment buildings in the distance, no text or logos. Most of the background is a vivid blue sky and three-dimensional white cumulus clouds. Warm backlighting from the low sun at the bottom left edges the hair, cheeks, neck, and thin blouse fabric in gold. Soft reflected light from the sky and rooftop floor fills the face. One small circular lens flare is left near the waist.

promptZh:
主题：
云端下的白衣

主体：
一位成熟女性站在阳光明媚的城市天台上。人物位于画面中心偏右，取景范围从头顶到大腿。人物占据约 70% 的画面，静静地俯视着低角度的镜头。

人物与表情：
肤色明亮自然，五官精致。精致的日系妆容，搭配粉米色唇妆、淡玫瑰色腮红、细棕色眼线，睫毛强调长度而不显夸张。深棕色齐肩波波头，带有薄刘海和脸部周围的层次感，发梢和碎发随风飘动。下巴微收，以平静、成熟的目光注视镜头，双唇微启。

服装与姿势：
一件微透的象牙白衬衫。柔和的浅 V 领，宽松长袖，袖口纤细。内搭简单的肤色米色吊带背心，透视感恰到好处，展现出胸部和身体轮廓的优雅。 下身搭配浅米色高腰百褶短裙。上半身略微前倾，双肩放松，双臂自然垂于身体两侧。衬衫的轻薄面料和裙摆在风中轻轻摇曳，在腰部形成自然的褶皱和阴影。

环境与光影：
城市公寓楼的天台。腰部高度的金属围栏，远处是低矮的住宅和公寓楼，无文字或标志。背景大部分是鲜艳的蓝天和立体感十足的积云。左下方低角度的暖色逆光为头发、脸颊、颈部和轻薄的衬衫面料勾勒出金色轮廓。 来自天空和天台地面的柔和反射光照亮了面部。腰部附近留有一个小圆形的镜头光晕。
